title: Punchlist finding (punch item)
description: One audited instance of a named defect. Symptom and evidence are separate on purpose: the symptom is what a person experiences, the evidence is the proof — evidence cannot be filled with an opinion.

defect.description: Primary defect id from the taxonomy. Exactly one; use also_matches for genuine multi-classification. Counting happens on primaries only.

also_matches.description: Other taxonomy ids this one instance genuinely satisfies. Never counted in headlines.

standard.description: Derived from the defect's taxonomy entry at write time. Never author-supplied — two sources drift.

oneOf.description: Comparison findings (the consistency family) exist only as a relationship between two surfaces.

symptom.description: What a user experiences. One line.

evidence.description: The proof: file:line, measured value, computed style, DOM read. Not an opinion.

verified_how.description: Which claim is being made. Measured-in-browser, read-in-source, and seen-in-an-image are different epistemic objects. frame-limited means the only evidence is what an image showed — it cannot distinguish content the product truncated from content the frame cut, nor data the product omitted from labels a chart library elided. A frame-limited finding is a question, not a defect.

manifestation.description: coincidentally-correct: the mechanism is wrong but the output is right at some sites — the worst case, because it is trusted and then wrong when it matters.

severity.description: Mean of independent critic ratings on the 0-4 scale, rated post-merge on the full deduplicated list. 0 = 'not a problem' — the false-positive veto.

severity_basis.description: Which declared audit basis this severity scores against. Bases are declared per-audit, before the sweep — never invented per-finding.

fix.description: The remedy. Required — a finding without a remedy is a complaint.

fixed_how.description: mechanical = applied and re-verified by full re-sweep of the touched surface; proposed = diff offered; reported-only = judgment call.

blocks_scope.description: Scope this finding renders unverifiable (e.g. 'all keyboard checks below this nav'). Re-sweeps must report dependents as unverifiable, not absent.

unverifiable_due_to.description: Finding id whose presence blocked verification of this check.

refs.description: Standards hooks: WCAG SC, failure technique, HIG/GOV.UK/Material citation.
